known_pitfall_claim: The naturality equation on line 15 is well-typed with its right-hand hom-bifunctor mapping taken in C.
pitfall_counterexample: Let C and D be distinct tagged copies of the discrete category on {0,1}. Let F:D→C and G:C→D preserve labels. Define α(d,c):Hom_C(Fd,c)→Hom_D(d,Gc) by the canonical label-preserving bijection. Take D₁=D₂=0, C₁=C₂=0, with f=id₀ in D and g=id₀ in C.
